selection_principle: Choose a work by the historical question it can sustain across ten years, not by who looks most successful at the endpoint.

topic_pool.central_question: 同一代人离开博士阶段后，所谓稳定究竟可以有多少种彼此不可通约的形式？
topic_pool.strength: Carries career, city, housing, research, public-sector and industry histories without a winner scale.
topic_pool.risk: Requires disciplined viewpoint hierarchy or the ensemble can become diffuse.

topic_pool.central_question: 专业判断最难的部分，会不会是知道何时坚持、何时缩小、何时停止？
topic_pool.strength: Strong research and technical-labor structure with failure, negative evidence and stopping decisions.
topic_pool.risk: Narrower social world; housing, city and public-sector lines recede.

topic_pool.central_question: 一个人因为可靠而不断被需要之后，怎样避免可靠最终变成无限兜底？
topic_pool.strength: Distinctive organizational theme: standards, escalation, second judges, exception governance and authority boundaries.
topic_pool.risk: More workplace/institutional than domestic; emotional drama must come from lived costs rather than plot twists.

topic_pool.central_question: 第一次工作已经变成生活之后，一个成年人还有多大能力重新选择？
topic_pool.strength: Midcareer recalibration, selective mobility, failed application, successful relocation and housing lock-in create clear delayed consequences.
topic_pool.risk: Underplays the early doctoral/research texture unless the first third remains substantial.

topic_pool.central_question: 如果收入、学术、稳定、城市、家庭距离、住房和自主都不能被压成一条排名，人生还怎样被比较？
topic_pool.strength: Closest to the entire historical thesis and supports a broad social panorama.
topic_pool.risk: High abstraction risk; requires concrete scenes to avoid becoming a thesis novel.

architecture_options.engine: One person's changing definition of a good life; the rest of the ensemble appears as real alternatives rather than subplots that must resolve.
architecture_options.advantage: High emotional concentration and easiest literary control.
architecture_options.cost: Loses much of the simulated world's strongest feature: different choices remain valid at the same time.

architecture_options.engine: Cross-cut two long arcs whose choices point in different directions but are each evidence-grounded.
architecture_options.cost: Other four new actors become mirrors and the public-sector/research breadth narrows.

architecture_options.engine: Six same-generation trajectories carry the macro history; the original eight recur where relationships and institutions actually intersect them.
architecture_options.advantage: Best balance between breadth, continuity, historical thesis and scene-level manageability.
architecture_options.cost: Needs unequal but controlled viewpoint weights; mechanical six-way rotation would feel schematic.

architecture_options.engine: A social network is the protagonist; episodes follow institutions, relationships and delayed consequences across nodes.
architecture_options.advantage: Most faithful to simulation and strongest for a multi-season television/animation project.
architecture_options.cost: Weakest fit for a first novel; high cognitive load and high risk of functional characters.

four_part_time_structure.label: 第一次定价
four_part_time_structure.question: 博士训练怎样被翻译成第一份工作，哪些翻译失败？

four_part_time_structure.label: 工作变成生活
four_part_time_structure.question: 收入、时间、住房、城市和职业身份怎样把选择变成日常？

four_part_time_structure.label: 第二次选择
four_part_time_structure.question: 有人留下、有人落选、有人换城以后，移动与不移动各自意味着什么？

four_part_time_structure.label: 治理已经做出的选择
four_part_time_structure.question: 当锁定已经发生，人还能怎样恢复判断、退出能力和局部可逆性？

novel_shape.viewpoint_rule: Do not rotate mechanically. A chapter belongs to the actor whose decision uncertainty is highest in that scene cluster.
novel_shape.ending_rule: End on ordinary continuing life, not a ten-year verdict or winner table.

series_shape.episode_rule: Each episode carries one major ledger arc plus one ordinary-life counterpoint; no episode must advance all six actors.
series_shape.finale_rule: Use unresolved but matured choices; avoid retrospective destiny narration.

era_lens: Advanced training must be translated into institutions that price different forms of usefulness.
Stability accumulates through welfare, organization knowledge, housing, city networks and habits, not through one decision.
Mobility is not automatically freedom and staying is not automatically entrapment.
Professional maturity increasingly concerns boundaries, stopping rules, escalation and transfer of judgment.
Negative evidence, failed applications, no-opening years and ordinary conversations are historical action rather than empty time.
primary_proposal.adaptation_only_fiction_policy: Private domestic details, scene geography, minor dialogue, composite side characters and connective moments may be invented only when labeled adaptation-only and must not contradict ledger facts.

next_storyteller_tasks: Build a protagonist-weight map for the six-core proposal.
Select 20-30 evidence-backed scene reservoirs before writing prose.
Produce a 20-24 chapter novel beat sheet and a separate 12-episode screen beat sheet.
Run 3 disposable scene probes from the same historical event with different viewpoints.
Choose a final working title only after scene probes reveal the dominant emotional register.
